A '''battle''' occurred in the [[Lianna system/Legends|Lianna system]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], where the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] reclaimed the Lianna system in [[3960 BBY]] before using it as a staging ground for the [[Battle of Malachor V]].

==Behind the scenes==
The battle is only referenced once in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It is marked on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] map showing the battles of the Mandalorian Wars rather than described in prose.
